item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import anndata as ad
import numpy as np
a=ad.read_h5ad('10x_pbmc68k_reduced.h5ad')
mask=(a.obs['bulk_labels']=='CD19+ B') & (a.obs['percent_mito']<0.04)
print('cells', mask.sum())
srm=a[:, 'SRM'].X
mrps=a[:, 'MRPS21'].X
if isinstance(srm,np.ndarray):
 s=srm[mask]
 m=mrps[mask]
else:
 s=np.asarray(srm[mask]).ravel()
 m=np.asarray(mrps[mask]).ravel()
print('s', s)
print('m', m)
diff=s-m
n_srm=(diff>1.0).sum()
n_mrps=(diff< -1.0).sum()
n_within=((diff>=-1.0)&(diff<=1.0)).sum()
print(n_srm,n_mrps,n_within,n_srm+n_mrps+n_within)
print(diff.min(),diff.max())
# unique differences maybe discrete
print(np.unique(diff,return_counts=True))
PY"
